propositions: docs/README.md currently conflates audience routing, policy, ownership, and historical evidence in a single file that must be reorganized by audience cohort.
The documentation landing page must provide distinct, labeled routes for clients, contributors, architecture readers, ADR readers, operators, research readers, and evidence readers.
Every maintained top-level Markdown page must appear exactly once in a compact directory within docs/README.md, classified under a single audience route.
The three existing troubleshooting rows and their remedies must remain present and discoverable on the reorganized landing page.
Outdated claims about six-relation ticket links and shared ADR numbers must be removed; generated-artifact tables remain on docs/generated-artifacts.md.
